title: ORBI BEACH TOWER — 1+1 with park and sea view
description: Apartment in ORBI BEACH TOWER at 57 Sherif Khimshiashvili St., 29th floor: 1+1 layout, 50 m². Underfloor heating throughout (three circuits). Excellent balcony with park and sea view, panoramic windows, sunny side with view towards Turkey and aircraft. Appliances and furniture: Bosch oven, built-in Gorenje microwave, Gorenje dishwasher, large Samsung fridge, Samsung 65" TV, Nardi balcony furniture (Italy), solid oak dining table and chairs (Belarus), Samsung washing machine, built-in wardrobes — ample storage. Kaczyński Park directly in front, Metrocity, restaurants and fitness nearby; promenade and beach across the road. Price approximately $130,000 — confirm current price and deal terms with your manager.
